about: The product's structure: kinds, their categories, and subcategories. Every meta.json names its place with `kind`, `category` and, where the category has them, `subcategory`; every recipe names its `category` under Screens. Platform (web, native) and tier (free, pro) are filters, not categories. A category whose description names places that hold only Pro components also has `coreDescription`, the sentence for the free Core.

categories.name: Actions
categories.description: Things you press: buttons, confirmations and buttons with an effect.
categories.coreDescription: Things you press: buttons, a copy button and an icon toolbar.

categories.name: Forms
categories.description: Text entry, choices, pickers, and the labels and validation around them.

categories.name: Feedback
categories.description: Status, loading and messages: badges, alerts, progress, skeletons, toasts, empty states.

categories.name: Overlays
categories.description: Dialogs, menus and popovers that open above the page.

categories.name: Navigation
categories.description: Moving within a page and around an app: tabs, breadcrumbs, pagination, navbars, sidebars.
categories.coreDescription: Moving within a page: tabs, breadcrumbs and pagination.

categories.name: Display
categories.description: Showing content: containers, people, numbers, lists, charts, tables and boards.
categories.coreDescription: Showing content: containers, people and numbers.

categories.name: AI
categories.description: Conversation and agent work: composers, streaming output, steps, results, diffs, voice.

categories.name: Showpieces
categories.description: Art-directed cards and galleries that carry their own stage, and wrappers that set what they hold in motion.

categories.name: Expo patterns
categories.description: React Native and Expo patterns, not yet sorted into the categories above; they take the same categories, with platform as a filter, when the native core is built.

kinds.name: Bands
kinds.description: Page sections: openers, proof, features, pricing and closers.

categories.name: Openers
categories.description: The first thing on a page.

categories.name: Proof
categories.description: Logos, testimonials and numbers that back a claim.

categories.name: Features
categories.description: Sections that show what a product does and how it changes.

categories.name: Closers
categories.description: The last call to action and the footer.

kinds.name: Screens
kinds.description: Whole screens, built from a recipe (get_recipe).

categories.name: Getting in
categories.description: Signing in and the first minutes.
